question: Are there elements, other than pitch, that can potentially result in out of key converted singing?
title: PitchNet: Unsupervised Singing Voice Conversion with Pitch Adversarial Network
answer_rationale: The evidence indicates that pitch is not the only factor affecting out-of-key converted singing; the quality of the converted singing voice is also dependent on the musical expression and timbre similarity, and pitch information may not be modeled precisely in some methods.
